_doc: Maintainer run state; the skill updates it at the end of a run, the scripts only read it. feeds.<id>.value = last reviewed version (or fingerprint); pages.<id>.reviewed = YYYY-MM-DD; contracts.last_audited_commit = the HEAD the last contracts audit covered; contracts.known_warnings = WARN lines the owner rejected, deferred or noted (check_contracts.py prints them as KNOWN); pending_dry_runs = accepted 'needs dry run' changes awaiting the owner's dry run. A missing entry means 'never reviewed'.

ecc.note: The three agents in third_party/ecc/manifest.json were vendored at this commit (2026-11-16).
